diffs.diff: header pin 2: part says MID, datasheet reading says middle
diffs.evidence: Same physical pin, different name only. The Joy-IT KY-011 product photo shows the 3-pin header silkscreened 'S' at one end and '-' at the other with the middle pin unlabelled; the second reading simply called it 'middle', the model calls it 'MID' (described as 'Middle pin (unlabelled): red LED anode'). Joy-IT's pin-assignment table confirms the three connections: LED GREEN (S), LED RED (middle), GND (-), common cathode. Position, role (io) and function agree.
